introduction.zh: 三月的风、四月的雨都过去了，六月的阳光照在田野上，约翰·杜立德终于回到自己的国家——却没有回帕德尔比的家。他赶着吉卜赛大车走集市，招牌上写着：六便士，看非洲丛林来的双头怪兽。他为什么不回家？
introduction.en: Spring is over and the June sun is on the English fields. John Dolittle is back in his own country — but not in Puddleby. He drives a painted wagon from fair to fair, with a sign: sixpence to see the two-headed animal from Africa. Why isn’t he going home?

sentences: 三月的风来了又走了；四月的阵雨过去了；五月的花苞开成了花；六月的阳光照在宜人的田野上，这时约翰·杜立德终于回到了自己的国家。

hints.zh: 约翰·杜立德，就是医生本人；书里说正经事时才会连名带姓地叫他。
hints.en: John Dolittle: the Doctor himself; the book uses his full name when the tone is serious.

sentences: 可是他还没有回帕德尔比的家。
他先带着「推我拉你」乘一辆吉卜赛大车周游各地，在每个乡村集市上停下来。
在那里，一边是杂技艺人，另一边是潘趣与朱迪木偶戏，他们就挂出一块大招牌，上面写着：「快来看来自非洲丛林的神奇双头动物。
门票六便士。」

hints.zh: 帕德尔比，医生的家乡小镇；全名「沼泽边的帕德尔比」。
hints.en: Puddleby: the Doctor’s home town, short for Puddleby-on-the-Marsh.

hints.zh: 「推我拉你」，那头两个头的动物，医生从非洲带回来的。
hints.en: The pushmi-pullyu (“push me, pull you”): the two-headed animal he brought back from Africa.

hints.zh: 潘趣与朱迪，英国街头常见的木偶戏。
hints.en: Punch-and-Judy: a traditional English puppet show, played in the street.

sentences: 「推我拉你」待在车里，别的动物就躺在车子底下。
医生坐在车前的椅子上收六便士，一边看着人们走进去，一边冲他们笑；达布达布则一直忙着数落他，因为只要她一不留神，他就会让孩子们白看。

hints.zh: 达布达布，医生的鸭子，管着家里的钱和规矩。
hints.en: Dab-Dab, the Doctor’s duck, who keeps an eye on the money and the rules.

sentences: 还有巡回动物园的老板和马戏团的人跑来，请医生把这头奇怪的动物卖给他们，说愿意为他出一大笔钱。
可医生总是摇摇头说：

hints.zh: 巡回动物园的老板；menagerie 指流动展出的动物。
hints.en: Menagerie-keepers: owners of travelling collections of animals.

sentences: 「不行。
「推我拉你」绝不能被关进笼子里。
他应该永远自由地来去，就像你我一样。」

quiz.question: Why does Dab-Dab keep scolding the Doctor?
options: He lets children in without paying.
He charges too much for the show.
He forgets to feed the animals.

feedback.zh: 原文说只要达布达布没留神，医生就会让孩子们白看，所以她一直忙着数落他。
feedback.en: The text says he would let the children in for nothing whenever she was not looking, so she was kept busy scolding him.

quiz.question: What does the Doctor refuse to do?
options: Sell the pushmi-pullyu to a circus
Show the animal at country fairs

feedback.zh: 马戏团和动物园的人出大钱要买这头动物，医生每次都摇头：他要让它自由来去，绝不关进笼子。
feedback.en: Menagerie-keepers and circus-men offered a lot of money, but he always shook his head: the animal must be free, never shut in a cage.

grammar.excerpt: they would hang out a big sign

focus.zh: would hang out 不是「愿意挂」，而是说过去每到一处集市都这么挂：一种旧习惯。
focus.en: Would hang out does not mean willingness or the future: it describes what they did again and again at every fair.

introduction.zh: 一路上的新鲜事不少，可比不上在外国见过的大事。几个星期后，马戏班的日子又长又闷，人人都开始想家；小车前排队的人却越来越多。这样的日子还要过多久？
introduction.en: There are new sights on the road, but after Africa they look ordinary. A few weeks of fairs and the animals are tired of it; they want their own beds and their own garden. Yet the crowds at the wagon grow bigger every day. How long can this go on?

sentences: 在这段漂泊的日子里，他们见过许多稀奇的东西和事情；可比起他们在外国见过的、做过的大事，这些全都显得平平常常。
一开始，多少算马戏班的一分子，还挺有意思；可几个星期之后，他们全都厌烦得不行，医生和大家一样都盼着回家。
可是来的人太多了，他们成群结队地涌向那辆小车，付六便士进去看「推我拉你」，所以没过多久，医生就不用再当班主了。

hints.zh: 跑江湖的班主，靠展览、表演赚钱的人。
hints.en: A showman: someone who earns money by putting on shows.

sentences: 有一天，正当蜀葵开得满满的时候，他回到了帕德尔比，成了一个有钱人，住进那座带大花园的小房子。
马厩里那匹瘸腿的老马见到他很高兴；那些已经在他屋檐下筑了巢、还孵出了雏鸟的燕子也一样高兴。
达布达布也很高兴回到她那么熟悉的屋子——尽管要打扫的地方实在太多，到处都是蛛网。
吉普跑去把它的金项圈给隔壁那条自以为了不起的牧羊犬看过之后，回来就在花园里像发了疯一样到处跑，找它很久以前埋下的骨头，还把老鼠从工具棚里赶出去；咕咕则把墙角那棵长到三英尺高的辣根拱了出来。

hints.zh: 隔壁那条自以为了不起的牧羊犬；collie 是牧羊犬。
hints.en: The conceited collie next door: a proud sheepdog.

hints.zh: 辣根，根茎辛辣的植物；猪爱把它拱出来啃。
hints.en: Horseradish: a plant with a hot root, which pigs like to dig up.

quiz.question: Why do the Doctor and the animals get tired of the wandering life?
options: The fairs seem ordinary after what they saw in Africa.
The wagon is too small for all of them.
Nobody comes to see the two-headed animal.

feedback.zh: 原文说这些新鲜事比起他们在外国见过、做过的大事都显得平常，几个星期后大家就都厌倦了。
feedback.en: The text says the sights looked quite ordinary after the great things they had seen abroad, and after a few weeks they were all tired of it.

quiz.question: What does the crowd at the little wagon make possible?
options: The Doctor can stop being a showman.
The Doctor can buy a bigger wagon.
The animals can stop working at night.

feedback.zh: 来的人太多，六便士的门票源源不断，所以没过多久医生就不用再当班主了。
feedback.en: So many people paid sixpence to go in that very soon the Doctor was able to give up being a showman.

grammar.excerpt: after Jip had gone and shown his golden collar

focus.zh: had gone and shown 比 came back 更早：吉普先给隔壁的狗看项圈，然后才跑回花园。
focus.en: Had gone and shown happened before came back: first he showed the collar to the dog next door, then he ran back into the garden.

introduction.zh: 回到帕德尔比，医生的钱多到要把旧存钱盒装满，还得再买三个。他拿这些钱去还债、买礼物，也给白鼠买回一架钢琴。可远在非洲的猴子们，夜里还在问同一个问题。
introduction.en: Back in Puddleby the Doctor has more money than his old money-box can hold, so he buys three more. He pays back old debts, buys presents, and gives the white mice a new piano. Far away in Africa, the monkeys still ask one question at night. What is it?

sentences: 医生去看望了那个把船借给他的水手，给他买了两条新船，又给他的宝宝买了一个橡皮娃娃；他还把欠杂货店老板的钱付了——去非洲的路上，那些食物是老板赊给他的。
他又买了一架钢琴，把白鼠放回琴里——因为它们说五斗柜的抽屉漏风。
即使把餐具柜搁板上那个旧存钱盒装满了，他剩下的钱还是很多；他只好又买了三个一样大的存钱盒，把其余的钱装进去。

hints.zh: 餐具柜上的搁板；dresser 这里指厨房里的餐具柜。
hints.en: The shelf of the dresser: the kitchen cupboard where plates are kept.

sentences: 「钱，」他说，「真是个麻烦东西。
不过不用操心钱的事，倒挺好。」
「是啊，」正在给他烤茶点小圆饼的达布达布说，「说得太对了！」

hints.zh: 英式小圆饼，烤热了抹上黄油，配茶吃。
hints.en: Muffins: small round cakes, toasted and eaten with butter at tea.

sentences: 等到冬天又来了，雪花打在厨房的窗户上，晚饭后医生和他的动物们就围坐在又大又暖的火炉边；他会从书里念故事给他们听。
可在遥远的非洲，猴子们在棕榈树上叽叽喳喳，然后在又大又黄的月亮下上床睡觉之前，他们会互相说：
「不知道那位好人现在在做什么——在那边，在白人的地方！
你觉得他还会回来吗？」

hints.zh: 「好人」，猴子们对杜立德的称呼。
hints.en: “The Good Man”: what the monkeys call the Doctor.

hints.target: the Land of the White Men
hints.zh: 「白人的地方」，猴子眼中的远方，指英国。
hints.en: “The Land of the White Men”: Britain, as the monkeys picture it.

sentences: 波利尼西亚就会从藤蔓里尖声叫出来：

hints.zh: 波利尼西亚，医生的鹦鹉。
尖声叫出来；squeak 是老鼠、小鸟那种又高又细的声音。
hints.en: To squeak out: to say something in a high, thin voice.

sentences: 「我想他会——我猜他会——我希望他会！」
这时鳄鱼会从河里的黑泥中朝他们咕哝：
「我敢肯定他会——睡觉吧！」

quiz.question: What does the Doctor do with his money first?
options: He pays back the sailor and the grocer.
He sends it to the monkeys in Africa.

feedback.zh: 他给借船的水手买了两条新船和一个橡皮娃娃，又付清了路上赊账的食物钱。
feedback.en: He bought two new ships and a rubber doll for the sailor who lent him the boat, and paid the grocer for the food.

quiz.question: What do the monkeys in Africa talk about at night?
options: What the Good Man is doing and whether he will come back

feedback.zh: 棕榈树上的猴子们互相问：那位好人在白人的地方做什么，他还会不会回来。
feedback.en: Up in the palm-trees the monkeys ask each other what the Good Man is doing over there, and whether he will ever come back.

grammar.excerpt: I wonder what The Good Man’s doing now

focus.zh: wonder 后面接 what 从句，从句用陈述语序 The Good Man’s doing，不能说 what is he doing。
focus.en: Wonder takes a wh-clause with statement order: what The Good Man’s doing, not what is he doing.
